verdict.rationale: The product consists of agent-oriented SKILL.md documents that are installed into agents such as Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and Pi, so an agent can be pointed at agent-facing instructions. There is no evidence of an llms.txt, and the probe for a markdown docs endpoint returned HTTP 404. Missing for 10: an llms.txt or llms-full.txt index, a published agent-readable docs endpoint (the .md probe 404'd), independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: Seven independently versioned Skills help agents use Ledger Records, understand projects, plan work, and deliver one bounded task.
Inspect the current product architecture, dependencies, and validation loops before planning or implementing a requested change.
